name: Scentcast
author: David Beck
description: What to wear from my fragrance wardrobe for today's weather, in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: The fragrance to wear now for the weather and time of day, with why, a runner-up and the week's day and night plan. Needs Node.js.

schema.label: Location
schema.description: A city, or lat,lon. Empty follows the Omarchy weather location, then your IP address.

schema.label: Switched-off bottles
schema.description: Comma-separated names to leave out, like Manage in the app. Unset keeps the site's defaults; empty shows every bottle.

schema.label: Wear journal
schema.description: The app's Copy for Claude (Wardrobe › Worn), or the path to a file holding it or a journal export, so the plan skips what you just wore and applies your stars. A pasted copy goes stale; a file is read again on every refresh. Empty plans without your wears.
